items.title: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
items.summary: Treasury yields moved lower on Wednesday as investors sought shelter from a sell-off in equity futures sparked by potential big victories from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: Blackstone president calls for more equity to fund AI buildout as debt risks mount
items.summary: The artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout will need more equity financing as lenders become increasingly exposed to the companies driving the buildout, Blackstone President Jon Gray said Tuesday.

items.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
items.summary: Job openings surged in September, as did the number of workers who quit their positions, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Tuesday, while hiring also rose and layoffs dropped.
